item.title: fix(auto-reply): mark truncated row lists in export-session warnings …
item.summary: fix(auto-reply): mark truncated row lists in export-session warnings (#119230) The skipped malformed transcript row warning prints the total count followed by a row-number sample capped at 20, with no indication the list is partial, so messages like "Skipped 25 ... rows 1, ..., 20" read as if every skipped row were listed. Append an ellipsis when the count exceeds the retained sample.
